legend: Ghosts live in harmony and peace, they travel the space without any purpose other than scare whoever stands in their way.

There are n%%ZSMJ0%% ghosts in the universe, they move in the OXY%%ZSMJ1%% plane, each one of them has its own velocity that does not change in time: →V=Vx→i+Vy→j%%ZSMJ2%% where Vx%%ZSMJ3%% is its speed on the x%%ZSMJ4%%-axis and Vy%%ZSMJ5%% is on the y%%ZSMJ6%%-axis.

A ghost i%%ZSMJ7%% has experience value EXi%%ZSMJ8%%, which represent how many ghosts tried to scare him in his past. Two ghosts scare each other if they were in the same cartesian point at a moment of time.
As the ghosts move with constant speed, after some moment of time there will be no further scaring (what a relief!) and the experience of ghost kind GX=∑ni=1EXi%%ZSMJ9%% will never increase.

Tameem is a red giant, he took a picture of the cartesian plane at a certain moment of time T%%ZSMJ10%%, and magically all the ghosts were aligned on a line of the form y=a⋅x+b%%ZSMJ11%%. You have to compute what will be the experience index of the ghost kind GX%%ZSMJ12%% in the indefinite future, this is your task for today.
Note that when Tameem took the picture, GX%%ZSMJ13%% may already be greater than 0%%ZSMJ14%%, because many ghosts may have scared one another at any moment between [−∞,T]%%ZSMJ15%%.
input: The first line contains three integers n%%ZSMJ16%%, a%%ZSMJ17%% and b%%ZSMJ18%% (1≤n≤200000%%ZSMJ19%%, 1≤|a|≤109%%ZSMJ20%%, 0≤|b|≤109%%ZSMJ21%%) — the number of ghosts in the universe and the parameters of the straight line.

Each of the next n%%ZSMJ22%% lines contains three integers xi%%ZSMJ23%%, Vxi%%ZSMJ24%%, Vyi%%ZSMJ25%% (−109≤xi≤109%%ZSMJ26%%, −109≤Vxi,Vyi≤109%%ZSMJ27%%), where xi%%ZSMJ28%% is the current x%%ZSMJ29%%-coordinate of the i%%ZSMJ30%%-th ghost (and yi=a⋅xi+b%%ZSMJ31%%).
It is guaranteed that no two ghosts share the same initial position, in other words, it is guaranteed that for all (i,j)%%ZSMJ32%% xi≠xj%%ZSMJ33%% for i≠j%%ZSMJ34%%.
output: Output one line: experience index of the ghost kind GX%%ZSMJ35%% in the indefinite future.
note: There are four collisions (1,2,T−0.5)%%ZSMJ36%%, (1,3,T−1)%%ZSMJ37%%, (2,4,T+1)%%ZSMJ38%%, (3,4,T+0.5)%%ZSMJ39%%, where (u,v,t)%%ZSMJ40%% means a collision happened between ghosts u%%ZSMJ41%% and v%%ZSMJ42%% at moment t%%ZSMJ43%%. At each collision, each ghost gained one experience point, this means that GX=4⋅2=8%%ZSMJ44%%.
In the second test, all points will collide when t=T+1%%ZSMJ45%%.
The red arrow represents the 1-st ghost velocity, orange represents the 2-nd ghost velocity, and blue represents the 3-rd ghost velocity.
